Experimental_Design.Conditions: association-type-matching: matching (matching vs nonmatching) x association type (self-other, high-low reward, happy-neutral); self-matching: matching (matching vs nonmatching) x identity (self, friend, stranger) x emotion (control, neutral, happy, sad)

Block_Structure.Block_number: association-type-matching: 2 blocks per association sub-task, renumbered globally 1-6 (self-other 1-2, happy-neutral 3-4, reward 5-6); self-matching: 6 blocks; per session
Block_Structure.Trial_number: per participant across the 6 sessions: 3456 (association-type-matching; median, range 2880-4032) and 8640 (self-matching; median, range 7793-10080); per block: 96 (association-type-matching) and 240 (self-matching)
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 154 (association-type-matching; range 84-416) and 192 (self-matching; range 144-720), median per participant across sessions; the design value is to be confirmed by the original author (open item)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: association-type-matching: 6 geometric shapes - C.bmp=circle (圆形), D.bmp=diamond (菱形), S.bmp=square (正方形), P.bmp=pentagon (五边形), T.bmp=triangle (三角形), Tra.bmp=trapezoid (梯形). Self-matching: 3 shapes x 4 emotional expressions - c=perfect circle (正圆), hc=horizontal ellipse (横椭圆), vc=vertical ellipse (竖椭圆); emotion suffix: (none)=control, _eh=happy (高兴), _en=neutral (中性), _es=sad (悲伤).
Stimulus_Properties.Label: Chinese words: 你 (self), 生人 (stranger/other), 高兴 (happy), 中性 (neutral), ￥1 (low reward), ￥16 (high reward) in the association-type-matching task; 自己 (self), 朋友 (friend), 生人 (stranger) in the self-matching task.

exp1.detail: Two tasks of the same 36 participants merged into one experiment: (a) association-type-matching (Hu 2015; three interleaved association sub-tasks self-other / happy-neutral / high-low reward; source file Data_for_Exp1.csv) and (b) self-matching (Hu 2015; self-friend-stranger identity x emotional expression; source file Data_for_Exp2.csv). Session (1-6; 7 = participant 6031 only) = one lab visit; both tasks were run on the same visit, as verified from the raw Clock.StartTimeOfDay dates. Task column values are 'shape-matching' (association-type-matching; unified 2026-10-12, formerly 'matching') and 'self-matching'. The association type (self-other / happy-neutral / high-low reward) and the emotional expression are carried by extraIV1/extraIV2 and by the identity columns. Phase = practice / main. Block = global block number 1-6 per session (association task: 3 sub-tasks x 2 blocks renumbered - self-other 1-2, happy-neutral 3-4, reward 5-6; self-matching: 6 blocks); NA = practice. Trial = trial order within block (1-96 association task; 1-240 self-matching); NA = practice, so (Subject, Session, Block, Trial) identifies main trials only. Matching = Matching/Nonmatching (association task: from the raw Match column; self-matching: from shape vs label identity). Shape = stimulus image file name; the Shape-side identity columns describe the label word the shape was associated with, whereas the Label-side identity columns describe the presented label word (你=self, 生人=other, 高兴=happy, 中性=neutral, ￥1=1, ￥16=16; self-matching: 自己/朋友/生人 = self/friend/stranger). On 2026-10-12 the Label-side English/Standardized values of the 34,253 mismatching trials of the association task were corrected so that Origin/English/Standardized always describe the same (presented) stimulus. Non-identity stimuli are kept as-is in the identity columns (happy/neutral, ￥1/￥16; registered exception, cf. Lee_2023_Cognition £9/£1). extraIV1 = valence of the shape's association (positive: self/happy/high reward; neutral: other/neutral/low reward; NA in the self-matching task). extraIV2 = emotional expression of the shape stimulus (control/happy/neutral/sad; NA in the association task). ACC: 1 = correct, 0 = error, NA = no response (no blank cells). The between-subjects group (control vs subclinical depression) is not a column of this file; derive it from the BDI_Score column of Exp1 subj_info (control: BDI < 10, n = 30; subclinical depression: BDI > 20, n = 6). Data provenance: the standardized raw table Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData_Exp1_raw.csv (39 columns, 450,029 rows) is the union of the two GB18030 E-Prime exports (Data_for_Exp1.csv, Data_for_Exp2.csv) plus the Task column and four trial fields recovered from the original E-Prime logs (Stimulus, TrialListS.Sample, TrialListE.Sample, TrialList.Sample) - these make the Clean Shape/Block/Trial columns reproducible from the raw table; practice rows carry no log trial counter, so those four fields are empty for practice rows. The raw table is grouped by participant (association-task block first, then self-matching block) so that it can be split at whole-participant boundaries: Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData_Exp1_raw_part1.csv (participants 6001-6019, 235,749 rows) and _raw_part2.csv (6020-6036, 214,280 rows); the two parts share this experiment JSON. The Clean table (52.9 MB > 50 MB) is likewise split: _Clean_part1.csv (6001-6019, 235,748 rows) and _Clean_part2.csv (6020-6036, 214,280 rows); the two parts share one Codebook and this experiment JSON. Rows are ordered by participant, task, session, phase, block and trial. Known data issues: participant 6008, session 6 is incomplete (self-matching block 3 has 113 trials instead of 240; blocks 4-6 missing). The source export contains one all-blank record (participant 6015, session 6, association task): it is kept in the raw table and was removed from the Clean table on 2026-10-12. Raw Age values are inconsistent within four participants (6009: 20/26/33; 6031: the author-confirmed value 19 is not among the raw values), so subj_info Age is author-confirmed and remains an open item. 36 participants (30 control / 6 subclinical depression) were recorded; 3 participants (6008, 6015, 6031) were excluded by the authors from the final analysis but are retained in the database per the minimal-preprocessing convention. Data source: the original per-participant E-Prime logs and the author's merged exports are not yet archived in the repository input zone (open item); the cleaning script expects them under Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData_Raw/ (Task1_rawdata/, Task2_rawdata/ and Data_for_Exp1.csv / Data_for_Exp2.csv).
